===== easyeda version --help (exit=0) =====
Print version information

Usage:
  easyeda version [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for version

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

===== easyeda daemon --help (exit=0) =====
Manage the easyeda-agent background daemon

Usage:
  easyeda daemon [flags]
  easyeda daemon [command]

Available Commands:
  health      Check daemon health across the port range
  restart     Stop the local daemon, then start this CLI version in the foreground
  start       Start the daemon (blocks until SIGINT/SIGTERM)
  stop        Stop the identified local daemon on --ports' first port

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for daemon

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda daemon [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda project --help (exit=0) =====

===== easyeda doc --help (exit=0) =====
Discover every openable document in a window and open or switch between them.

  easyeda doc ls --project <name>                      list all schematic pages + PCBs, ★=active
  easyeda doc open <name|uuid> --project <name>        open a document (schematic page or PCB)
  easyeda doc switch <name|uuid> --project <name>      switch to a document (same as open)
  easyeda doc reload [name|uuid] --project <name>      save, close, and reopen a document
  easyeda doc ready [uuid] --project <name>            verify current readability without navigation

Context is read live (not the connect-time snapshot), so the active marker
and `daemon health` reflect the real foreground document. If the project has
no active editor tab, `doc ls` still uses project inventories and `doc open`
can recover by UUID, then confirms the new active document with a fresh read.

Usage:
  easyeda doc [flags]
  easyeda doc [command]

Available Commands:
  ls          List all openable documents in the window (★ = active)
  open        Open a document (schematic page or PCB) by name or uuid
  ready       Read current document identity and stable component inventory without opening or saving
  reload      Save + close + reopen a document (default: the active one) — refreshes per-doc engine state
  source      Inspect and probe the Beta native document source (no new design content)
  switch      Switch the foreground document by page name, PCB name, or uuid

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for doc
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID (usually prefer --project)

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda doc [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda sch --help (exit=0) =====
Schematic operations

Usage:
  easyeda sch [flags]
  easyeda sch [command]

Available Commands:
  align               Align parts' rendered bboxes (left|right|top|bottom|centerx|centery) to a reference part
  apply               Replay a declarative step file (playbook) against EasyEDA
  attribute-inspect   Inspect one active-page attribute's visibility through three official read paths
  attribute-move      Move one bound Name/Designator attribute using x/y only
  autoconnect         Pin-aware planner: auto-pick direction/offset and connect a pin (or batch) to a flag/netport
  autolayout          Module-aware planner: place parts by module zone with deterministic, lint-clean coordinates
  autoplace-free      Pack parts into the sheet's blank space (zone-less; keeps other parts fixed)
  block-apply         Instantiate a circuit block: place its parts, wire internal_nets, bind ports
  bridge-check        Detect共线合并短路 (bridges) and孤儿桩 (orphans) at wire-tree granularity
  check               Reconstructed per-item design check the SDK DRC can't itemize
  clear               Clear the active schematic page (delete all page primitives: components, flags, wires, buses, graphics)
  clusters            列出 L1 虚拟组(器件 + 它自己的 marker/桩线)并判组间重叠 / 出图纸
  compose             Compose authored Lib circuits onto one sheet and compile a guarded SCH Apply
  connect             Stub a wire out of a pin and place a netflag/netport at its far end
  connectivity        Export layout-independent schematic connectivity IR
  connectivity-diff   Compare two connectivity snapshots offline
  design-diff         Compare local schematic identity, connectivity, geometry and complete compose plans
  designator-geometry Export measured current-page Designator text bboxes (read-only)
  designators         Allocate official reference numbers and repair placed component bindings
  destagger           批量消 marker-overlap:换方向/桩长并带桩线一起挪(默认 dry-run;--apply 执行)
  disconnect          Remove a pin's stub wire and its netflag/netport together (inverse of connect)
  distribute          Equalize edge-to-edge gaps between parts along one axis (x|y)
  drc                 Run the official schematic DRC SDK gate (may be boolean/aggregate only)
  export-image        Render the page — or only the given primitives — to SVG/PNG/PDF
  extract-layout      Reverse-derive a block's schematic_layout template from a placed instance (issue #140)
  frame               Apply or verify computed module frames and titles from JSON
  gate                S5 校验门:按固定顺序跑 layout-lint → check → bridge-check → drc,出一张报告
  group               Persistent virtual groups (create/list/add/remove/ungroup) — the platform has NO grouping API
  group-arrange       第二层排布:把虚拟组当刚体,按**跨组信号网**关系铺进图纸可用区(ADR-0003)
  group-move          Translate components+wires together as one rigid assembly (dx,dy) — by --ids or persistent --group/--groups
  image               Non-electrical reference images on the schematic (photo/dimension/pinout diagrams, #272)
  layout-edit         Plan a core-relative move or protected pin-marker repair from retained data
  layout-lint         Check component placement for bbox overlaps and tight spacing
  layout-plan         Plan a measured component set offline without Lib or project metadata
  layout-render       Compile layout JSON to SVG offline (no AI, EDA or diff panels)
  layout-score        Score schematic layout readability (folded/reversed labels, proximity, chains) with executable fixes
  layout-sheet-plan   Pack existing zone geometry into sheet previews offline (no Apply)
  lib-layout          Calculate Lib placement and wiring offline from canonical nets and measured pins
  list                List components on the active (or all) schematic page(s)
  materialize         将 1.4 原理图数据转换为器件放置 Apply 队列
  modify              Modify component position, designator, BOM flags, or custom properties
  netflag             Create a power/ground/net flag or port
  netlist             Export schematic netlist as an artifact
  nets                跨页网名审计:同一条轨被写成多个名字 / 单引脚网(逐页命令看不见的那半)
  no-connect          Mark (or clear) a pin's no-connect flag (非连接标识)
  open                Open or activate a schematic page by UUID
  page-delete         Delete a schematic page (no undo)
  page-new            Create a new schematic page under a schematic document
  page-rename         Rename a schematic page
  pages               List schematic documents and pages in the current project
  place               Place a component from the device library at coordinates
  plan                Generate a guarded sch apply playbook for explicit marker additions, including NC-to-connected pins (offline)
  power-layout        Plan a four-part fixed AMS1117 power circuit offline from measured geometry
  prim-delete         Delete schematic primitives of ANY type by explicit id
  read                One-call semantic snapshot of the circuit (components + nets + check)
  rebind-footprint    Swap a footprint transactionally (candidate create/readback before original delete)
  rebind-symbol       Swap a symbol transactionally (candidate create/readback before original delete)
  reconcile           把「接对了没有」变成机械判据:从块库重推应有连接,与活体网表逐条对账
  rename              Rename a schematic document (the whole sheet, not a single page)
  replace             Replace a placed component with a different library device (换型号 / 器件标准化)
  resolve-lcsc        Deterministically resolve placed parts to their device's REAL LCSC C-number (dry-run; --apply writes back)
  save                Save the active schematic document
  sheet               Sheet 层操作(三层体系最外层)— tidy 全部功能区依据纸张排布
  sheet-geometry      Report sheet bounds + title-block keep-out geometry (provenance-tagged)
  status              原理图进度(S1–S6):逐条从活体推导,不落盘,判不了的明说
  text-list           List ALL text primitives on the active schematic page (id/content/x/y/…)
  titleblock          Adjust the focused page's 明细表 (title block): visibility and/or fields
  titleblock-get      Read a page's 明细表 (title block): show flag + field keys/values
  wire                Create a schematic wire polyline — ESCAPE HATCH; 常规布线走 `sch autoconnect` / `sch block-apply`
  zone                功能区层操作(三层体系:Sheet→Zone→Group)— move 整区刚移 / tidy 组间叠加布局
  zone-arrange        Two-phase deterministic zone layout plan: intra-zone compaction (R1-R5) + edge-affinity multi-shelf packing (A4-only, no mutation)
  zone-draw           Draw the claimed functional zones as dashed frames + labels on the sheet (--clear removes them)
  zone-plan           Plan data-driven A4 functional partitions from the live sheet + module bboxes (no mutation)
  zone-review         只读复核源 JSON 的 zone 归属，提示 AI 决定是否拆分
  zones               原理图分区认领(S0 modules[].zone → 图纸格位):set / status / clear

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for sch
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda sch [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda pcb --help (exit=0) =====
PCB operations

Usage:
  easyeda pcb [flags]
  easyeda pcb [command]

Available Commands:
  3d                   Inspect and adjust component 3D models on the active PCB
  add-component        Place + connect ONE footprint on the PCB (the working alternative to import-changes)
  align                Align components by edge/center (left|right|top|bottom|centerX|centerY)
  antenna-keepout      Auto-generate the all-layer no-copper keep-out over each RF/antenna part's antenna end
  arrange              Coarse auto-layout SEED: cluster by shared nets, or pack a grid
  auto-place           Module-aware auto placement: pull each satellite (cap/R/LED) to the chip pin it connects to
  autoroute            Auto-route the active PCB with the official EasyEDA router (or an external engine via --router)
  beautify             Round sharp track corners into arcs (走线美化) on the active PCB
  board-info           Read the current Board (schematic↔PCB linkage) + PCB info
  check                DFM audit: acute angles / dangling copper / bad vias / neck-down / 3W coupling (read-only)
  clear                One-shot PCB reset: components + routing + copper + regions + silk (keeps locked primitives & the board outline)
  clear-routing        Native clearRouting (@alpha — may be unavailable; prefer rip-up)
  config               Read and configure real PCB design rules (配置设置)
  delete               Delete PCB component primitives by id
  diff-pair            Differential pair constraints (create/list/rename/delete)
  distribute           Evenly space component centers along an axis (x|y)
  doc-delete           Delete one exact, unbound PCB document and verify it is gone (no undo)
  docs                 List PCB documents in the current project (uuid + name)
  drc                  Run PCB DRC and return normalized violations
  drc-rules            Read the active PCB's DRC rule configuration without running a check
  drc-rules-set        Set full PCB rules from JSON, or raise only the pour clearance
  dump                 Dump the board's read-only geometry to a self-contained JSON snapshot
  enclosure            Generate a printable two-part enclosure (STL) from a board readback (offline)
  eq-group             Equal-length net group constraints (create/list/add/delete)
  escape-plan          Jointly reserve measured pad escape paths offline (no editor writes)
  export-3d            Export real PCB OBJ/STEP with version-bound readbacks and file integrity checks
  export-dsn           Export the active PCB as a Specctra DSN (autorouter input)
  fill                 Net-bound filled region (填充区域 / 异形大块铜): create / list / delete
  floorplan            Plan ordered functional bands from the S0 signal flow (read-only)
  grid-snap            Snap component anchors to a grid (PCB data units, mil-scale)
  group                Persistent VIRTUAL component groups on the active PCB (mode=virtual — not EasyEDA UI groups)
  image                Manage embedded reference pictures on PCB document layer 13
  import-autoroute     Import a routed result (Specctra .ses / autoroute .json) into the active PCB
  import-changes       Sync the schematic netlist/components into the active PCB
  layer-set            Switch the active/edit PCB layer (id|name|top|bottom|inner1)
  layer-visibility     Show/hide/focus PCB layers (preset or explicit show/hide)
  layers               List layers of the active PCB (+ current layer, copper count)
  layout               Offline PCB placement/routing coordination
  layout-lint          Score PCB placement quality + predict routability (ratsnest crossings)
  layout-plan          Generate measured module placement candidates offline (no editor writes)
  layout-score         Score placement quality across 9 dimensions, with per-component attribution
  list                 List placed components/footprints on the active PCB
  lock                 Lock/unlock PCB components (batch, readback-verified)
  modify               Lay out a PCB component: move/rotate/flip layer/lock/designator
  module-check         Verify a routed module against fresh before/after copper snapshots and apply journal
  module-owned         Recover exact old module object ownership offline (no editor writes)
  mount-holes          Mill M3 corner clearance cutouts (no library component is imported)
  move                 Translate components by a relative (dx, dy) offset
  neckdown-plan        Plan narrowing track ends wider than the pad they enter (offline; emits an apply playbook)
  net-class            Inspect and create persisted EasyEDA PCB net classes
  net-classes          Print the net-class → spec track-width ladder (signal/power-branch/power-trunk/high-current/gnd)
  net-path             Prove a pad-to-pad path through listed tracks/arcs/vias (read-only; pours excluded)
  nets                 List nets on the active PCB (name, length, color)
  new-board            Create a NEW board (板) with a fresh empty PCB page, bound to an UNBOUND schematic
  origin               Read or set the PCB canvas/display origin (does not move geometry)
  outline-clear        Remove the current board outline (BOARD_OUTLINE layer)
  outline-fit          Resize the board outline to hug the placed parts + a margin (fix low utilization)
  outline-get          Read the board outline, including true center-line dimensions and rendered bbox
  outline-round        Set a rounded-rectangle board outline (圆角板框)
  outline-set          Set the board outline from a closed polygon of points (mil, y-up)
  place-constrained    Tiered placement: edge-must parts (connectors/module/IPEX) → board edge + locked, then legalize the rest
  pour                 Create a copper pour (铺铜) from a closed polygon, bound to a net (usually GND)
  pour-clean           Remove netless copper pours (net:"" dead copper — see `pcb check` netless-pour)
  pour-delete          Delete copper pour regions by primitiveId
  pour-fit             Auto-size a GND/power pour to the board outline, inset from the edge
  pour-list            List copper pours (铺铜), optionally by net
  pour-rebuild         Re-pour (recompute) all pours after layout/routing changes
  poured-list          List materialized copper after pour rebuild (exact polygon sources)
  power-planes         4-layer power distribution: GND 内电层 + power inner plane + via-stitch (fixes 2-layer pour conflict)
  power-pour           2-layer power distribution: pour GND + each rail's local copper (电源走铺铜块, not thin tracks)
  refine               Score-driven placement refinement with per-step rollback (dry-run by default)
  region               Keep-out / rule regions (禁止区域): create / list / delete
  report               Read-only design report: per-net length, net-class totals, diff-pair skew, equal-length spread
  rip-up               Rip up routing (delete tracks+vias); --net to scope, omit = all. Outline/locked are safe
  route                Offline single-layer path solving and independent checking
  route-critical       P7.0 critical nets first: power copper → diff pairs routed+measured → locked (issue #127)
  route-short          Self-route the short, clear hops: per-net MST, L-shaped tracks on the pads' layer
  save                 Save the active PCB document to disk
  silk-add             Add a free silkscreen string (board marking / credit / note) with config
  silk-align           Place component designators (位号) and verify measured collisions
  silk-import-svg      Import an SVG logo/artwork as a FILLED silkscreen graphic
  silk-label-pads      Label component pads with pin numbers / net names
  silk-netnames        Auto-generate network-name silkscreen labels in a zone
  silk-plan            Plan designator positions offline with real text extents and up to two orientations (emits an apply playbook)
  silk-set             Batch-adjust existing silk: position / rotation / size / text, or align to a reference
  silk-zone-outline    Auto-draw grouped orthogonal functional-zone outlines on silkscreen
  slot                 Board cutout / slot (挖槽) — a MULTI-layer fill that mills a hole
  snapshot             Capture the active PCB canvas as a PNG artifact
  stackup              Board stackup: copper layer count + inner-layer types (signal/plane)
  stage                Deprecated PCB checklist records: status / confirm-layout / confirm-outline / reset
  stage-snapshot       Capture a recording/demo STAGE: board-fitted viewport PNG + data bundle, verified PNG, capture identity and hashed data
  sync-attrs           Backfill PCB components' empty attribute values from the schematic (器件标准化字段)
  sync-designators     Repair placeholder PCB designators (U? / C?) from the schematic, matched by uniqueId
  teardrop-delete-plan 规划线条形泪滴的删除（离线，输出 typed apply 剧本）
  teardrop-modify-plan 规划线条形泪滴的尺寸修改（离线，输出 typed apply 剧本）
  teardrop-plan        Plan line-shaped teardrops at track→pad entries (offline; emits an apply playbook)
  track                Create a copper track (导线) on a layer between two points (mil, y-up)
  track-delete         Delete specific copper tracks by primitiveId (rip-up is net-scoped; this is surgical)
  track-list           List copper tracks (导线), optionally by net/layer
  track-lock           Lock/unlock routed copper (tracks/vias/fills) so the native router + pour-rebuild leave it alone
  via                  Place a via (过孔) at (x,y) with hole + outer diameter (mil, y-up)
  via-bond             Assign netless footprint-embedded vias (EPAD thermal vias) the net of the pad they sit in
  via-delete           Delete specific vias by primitiveId (rip-up is net-scoped; this is surgical)
  via-fence            Place a perimeter-only via fence around a rectangle
  via-hop              Route a layer hop: stub→via→hop-track→via→stub (optional bond fills)
  via-list             List vias (过孔), optionally by net
  via-stitch           Place a grid of net vias in a rectangle (thermal vias / GND stitching)
  view-filter          Read PCB canvas filter state (component-attribute write is unsupported)
  view-side            Switch the PCB view to the top or bottom side (for snapshots)
  zones                Functional zone claims (S0 modules[].zone → PCB, issue #126): set / status / clear

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for pcb
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda pcb [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda board --help (exit=0) =====
Manage Boards (板子/组合).

A Board groups exactly one schematic + one PCB — this is how the two are
kept together (and what `pcb import_changes` follows). Boards are identified
by NAME, not UUID.

Usage:
  easyeda board [flags]
  easyeda board [command]

Available Commands:
  copy        Copy a Board (its schematic + PCB) into a new Board
  create      Bind a schematic and/or PCB into a new Board (组合)
  current     Read the current Board (its bound schematic + PCB)
  delete      Delete a Board and the schematic + PCB documents it binds (no undo)
  list        List all Boards in the current project (name + schematic + pcb)
  new         Create a Board with a new schematic (one page) and a new PCB — works in an empty project
  rebind      Rebind a Board to the intended schematic + PCB (repair a stale binding)
  rename      Rename a Board by its current name

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for board
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda board [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda skill --help (exit=0) =====
Inspect and update the easyeda-agent skill installed for your AI clients.

  easyeda skill status                 show installed skill dirs + versions vs latest release
  easyeda skill sync                   update present skill dirs to the latest release
  easyeda skill sync --version 0.9.0   pin a specific version

The daemon syncs installed Skill dirs to its own version on startup; development builds skip writes.
CODEX_HOME / CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR override the default client config roots.
To update the CLI binary as well, use `easyeda update` (skill sync included).
The connector .eext is NOT covered here (no sideload auto-update) — the daemon
logs a re-import notice when it detects a stale connector.

Usage:
  easyeda skill [flags]
  easyeda skill [command]

Available Commands:
  status      Show installed skill dirs, their versions, and the latest release
  sync        Update installed skill dirs to the latest release (or a pinned --version)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for skill

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda skill [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda update --help (exit=0) =====
Bring this installation up to the latest GitHub release.

Covers the two pieces that CAN be updated programmatically:
  • the easyeda CLI binary itself (downloaded for this platform, sha256-verified
    when the release publishes checksums.txt, then atomically swapped in place)
  • the easyeda-agent skill dirs (~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills,
    and the shared ~/.agents/skills root used by Codex Desktop)

The EasyEDA connector .eext is only REPORTED: a sideloaded extension has no
in-place auto-update, so a stale connector has to be re-imported by hand
(marketplace installs update themselves, but lag the CLI).

A dev build (git-describe stamp) is never overwritten without --force.
If the binary lives in a root-owned dir, re-run with sudo.

Usage:
  easyeda update [flags]

Aliases:
  update, upgrade, self-update

Examples:
  easyeda update                    # CLI + skills → latest
  easyeda update --check            # report only, change nothing
  easyeda update --check --exit-code  # exit 10 when explicit install reconciliation finds a difference
  easyeda update --version 0.25.0   # pin a release
  easyeda update --skill-only       # leave the binary alone
  easyeda update --json
  easyeda update --local-dir ./dist --binary /absolute/path/to/easyeda  # install trusted local dev assets
  easyeda update --local-dir ./dist --check --exit-code                 # offline, exact local runtime reconciliation

Flags:
      --binary string      with --local-dir install: absolute destination of the PATH CLI (required)
      --check              verify target versions and connector compatibility without changing anything
      --cli-only           update only the CLI binary
      --client strings     limit skill sync to clients: claude,codex,agents (default: all present)
      --create-missing     install the skill into a client dir that doesn't exist yet
      --exit-code          with --check: exit 10 unless ready (local-dir requires exact dev versions and file contents)
      --force              overwrite a dev build / re-install even when already at the target
  -h, --help               help for update
      --json               emit JSON
      --local-dir string   install/check trusted X.Y.Z-dev.N assets from this local directory; never query GitHub
      --preserve           skill sync: keep local edits (never overwrite existing files)
      --restart-daemon     restart an installed daemon still running a different version on the updated binary (background; a make dev daemon is never touched) (default true)
      --skill-only         update only the skill dirs
      --version string     pin a release version (default: latest)

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

===== easyeda apply --help (exit=0) =====
Execute a playbook (see docs/design-apply-playbook.md) step by step:
typed actions, CLI subcommands, capture/assert gates, journal + resume.
Precedence: CLI flag > playbook file > built-in default.

Usage:
  easyeda apply <playbook.json> [flags]

Examples:
  easyeda apply sch.playbook.json
  easyeda apply pcb.playbook.json --project demo2 --var LIB=<uuid>
  easyeda apply pcb.playbook.json --resume
  easyeda apply pcb.playbook.json --dry-run

Flags:
      --doc string         target document to switch to first (overrides meta.doc)
      --dry-run            validate + print the plan, execute nothing
      --from string        start at step (id or 1-based index)
  -h, --help               help for apply
      --journal string     journal path (default <playbook>.journal.jsonl)
      --quiet              only print failures and the final summary
      --resume             skip steps already ok in the journal (restores captured vars)
      --step-delay float   pause N seconds between steps (demo / recording pacing)
      --to string          stop after step (id or 1-based index)
      --var stringArray    override/add a playbook var: KEY=VALUE (repeatable)
      --window string      EasyEDA window ID (overrides meta.window)
      --yes                auto-approve confirmation-gated steps

Global Flags:
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

===== easyeda api --help (exit=0) =====
Search and browse the embedded eda.* API index (93 namespaces, 742 methods,
generated from @jlceda/pro-api-types). No daemon or connected window required.

find the eda.* method, read its signature, then wrap it.

===== easyeda blocks --help (exit=0) =====
Query the standard circuit-block library — proven peripheral subcircuits
(CH340 USB-serial, ESP32 auto-download, XL1509 buck, SP3485 RS-485, CC1101 RF,
microSD…) whose internal topology is fixed and can be copied verbatim; only the
boundary nets (ports) get rebound to the host design.

The library is EMBEDDED in the binary, so these commands need no daemon, no open
EasyEDA window, and no skill files — a bare 'easyeda' install can look blocks up.

Usage:
  easyeda blocks [flags]
  easyeda blocks [command]

Available Commands:
  ls          List blocks (optionally filter by --category / --ready / --draft)
  search      Find blocks by id/desc/category/port/part (case-insensitive)
  show        Print a block's full JSON (parts, internal_nets, ports, notes)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for blocks

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda blocks [command] --help" for more information about a command.

===== easyeda workflow --help (exit=0) =====
Compatibility interface for the former per-project PCB workflow.

Historical stages:
  imported → placement_ready → placement_confirmed → outline_confirmed
           → pre_route_passed → routing_authorized

No stage is an execution permission. Route, placement, outline and raw typed
actions run from live project data regardless of these records. Mutations no
longer cascade through confirmations, and legacy --force options are no-ops.
Use connectivity, geometric checks, DRC and save/reload/readback as evidence.

State lives at ~/.easyeda-agent/workflow/<project>.json (EASYEDA_WORKFLOW_DIR
to override). Existing scripts may inspect or append it; `status` and
`advance` describe only the deprecated checklist and do not control
other commands.

Usage:
  easyeda workflow [flags]
  easyeda workflow [command]

Available Commands:
  advance     Advance the deprecated checklist and print its historical next step
  confirm     Record a historical layout/outline checklist entry (no execution permission)
  init        Initialize (or restart) the deprecated project checklist
  pages       逐页记账的工程归属表(--reap 用活体页表核销,--prune 删掉已证明外来的残留)
  reset       Clear deprecated checklist entries (or --all)
  status      Show deprecated checklist state; --reconcile compares it with the live document

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for workflow
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID (else use --project)

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda workflow [command] --help" for more information about a command.
